focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制全面实施，中国出口企业面临碳成本与申报双重合规挑战
focus.summary: 2026年11月10日，欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）结束过渡期进入全面实施阶段，覆盖钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力和氢六大行业。中国相关出口企业须按季度申报产品隐含碳排放，并购买CBAM证书，未合规将面临高额罚款。企业应尽快建立产品碳足迹核算体系，优化供应链低碳转型，并关注欧盟认可的第三方核查机构名单，以降低合规成本。
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Fully Operational: Chinese Exporters Face Dual Compliance Challenges on Carbon Costs and Reporting
focus.summary_en: On 10 November 2026, the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) concluded its transitional period and entered full implementation, covering six sectors: iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen. Chinese exporters in these sectors must now report embedded emissions quarterly and purchase CBAM certificates; non-compliance will trigger substantial penalties. Companies should urgently establish product carbon footprint accounting systems, decarbonise supply chains, and monitor the list of EU-accredited verification bodies to minimise compliance costs.

case.title: 香港仲裁裁决在内地获认可执行，法院明确公共政策抗辩的严格审查标准
case.summary: 近期，内地某中级人民法院审结一起申请认可和执行香港仲裁裁决案件。被申请人以裁决违反内地公共政策为由抗辩，法院指出公共政策抗辩应严格限缩适用，仅限裁决结果严重损害社会公共利益的情形，并强调仲裁庭对合同效力的认定属于实体审理范围，不构成程序瑕疵。本案对跨境仲裁裁决在内地的执行具有重要指导意义，提示企业应审慎评估公共政策抗辩的可行性。
case.source: 来源：最高人民法院案例库 · 2026.10
case.title_en: Mainland Court Enforces Hong Kong Arbitral Award, Clarifying Strict Standard for Public Policy Defence
case.summary_en: A mainland intermediate people's court recently ruled on an application to recognise and enforce a Hong Kong arbitral award. The respondent argued that enforcement would violate mainland public policy, but the court held that the public policy defence must be interpreted narrowly and applies only where enforcement would seriously harm social public interests. It further stressed that the tribunal's findings on contract validity are substantive matters, not procedural defects. The case offers important guidance for enforcing cross-border arbitral awards in the mainland and reminds companies to assess the viability of public policy challenges carefully.
case.source_en: Source: Supreme People's Court Case Database · 2026.10

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化新规出台，企业需关注数据出境安全评估豁免情形
policy.summary: 2026年11月，粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动便利化措施，进一步明确区内企业数据出境的安全评估豁免情形，涵盖研发、供应链管理等特定场景。新规简化了申报流程，并设立大湾区数据跨境流动服务中心提供咨询。企业应梳理自身数据出境场景，评估是否符合豁免条件，完善内部数据合规制度，并利用服务中心资源降低合规风险。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政务服务数据管理局 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: New Greater Bay Area Rules Facilitate Cross-Border Data Flows, Highlight Exemptions from Security Assessment
policy.summary_en: In November 2026, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area introduced measures to facilitate cross-border data flows, further clarifying exemptions from security assessment for data exports by companies in the region, covering specific scenarios such as R&D and supply chain management. The new rules streamline filing procedures and establish a Greater Bay Area cross-border data flow service centre for consultation. Companies should map their data export scenarios, assess eligibility for exemptions, improve internal data compliance systems, and leverage the service centre to mitigate compliance risks.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Management Bureau · 2026.11

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华投资限制新规扩围，企业应构建“投资+技术+供应链”三维合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期扩大对华投资限制范围，将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等领域纳入管控，并强化对现有投资的审查。中国企业应构建“投资+技术+供应链”三维合规体系：投资端审慎评估美资背景基金的投资条款，技术端加强自主研发与知识产权布局，供应链端推动多元化并建立溯源机制。同时，建议企业提前进行合规审计，预留政策缓冲期，以应对动态监管环境。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: US Expands Outbound Investment Restrictions on China; Companies Should Build a Three-Dimensional Compliance Framework Covering Investment, Technology and Supply Chains
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The United States has recently expanded its outbound investment restrictions on China, adding semiconductors, artificial intelligence and quantum computing to the controlled sectors and tightening reviews of existing investments. Chinese companies should build a three-dimensional compliance framework covering investment, technology and supply chains: on investment, carefully assess terms of US-backed funds; on technology, strengthen independent R&D and IP portfolios; on supply chains, promote diversification and establish traceability mechanisms. Companies are advised to conduct compliance audits in advance and allow a policy buffer period to navigate the dynamic regulatory environment.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Department of the Treasury · 2026.11
